# Theme-That-Shall-Not-Be-Named

This note records an Obsidian theme that applies a Slytherin- and Harry Potter-inspired color palette across the application, giving interface elements green-accented styling. The recorded description lists seven CSS snippets covering base colors, headings, fonts, graph view, checkboxes, blockquotes and tag buttons, which together restyle core interface and preview elements.

![Theme-That-Shall-Not-Be-Named screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/choptv/Obsidian-Theme-That-Shall-Not-Be-Named/HEAD/Theme-That-Shall-Not-Be-Named.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Theme-That-Shall-Not-Be-Named"
    author: "choptv"
    repo:   "choptv/Obsidian-Theme-That-Shall-Not-Be-Named"
    slug:   "theme-that-shall-not-be-named"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/theme-that-shall-not-be-named"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/choptv/Obsidian-Theme-That-Shall-Not-Be-Named"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/choptv/Obsidian-Theme-That-Shall-Not-Be-Named/HEAD/Theme-That-Shall-Not-Be-Named.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a Slytherin- and Harry Potter–inspired color palette across Obsidian to give UI elements green-accented, themed styling. Include seven CSS snippets for base colors, headings, fonts, graph view, checkboxes, blockquotes and tag buttons to restyle core UI and preview elements."
}
```
